tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_lycan_summon_wolves: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.

Max Level increased to %max_level%. Level 5 wolves gain Hamstring, which empowers their attacks to root enemies and cause them to take more physical damage on attacks. Level 6 wolves have Hightail, an active ability that gives wolves phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
Summoned Wolves are invulnerable and uncontrollable spirits that do not attack, but provide health and damage bonuses to Lycan.
The very enchantment that twisted his being also summons canine familiars.
Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.
Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_lycan_bio:
Banehallow was noble-born to the house of Ambry, the greatest of the landed castes in the old kingdom of Slom. Before the Fall, as the King's wants grew strange, and his court grew crowded with sorcerers and charlatans, the house of Ambry was the first to rise against the avarice of the throne. No longer willing to pay homage and fealty, they instead sent six-thousand swords into the capital, where they were wiped out in the Massacre of the Apostates. And then came the teeth behind the old truth: When you strike a king's neck, you had better take his head.

Enraged by the betrayal, the king exterminated the vast Ambry bloodline, sparing only the lord of the house and his youngest son, Banehallow. Before all the royal court, with the disgraced lord chained to the ornate marble floor, the King bade his magicians transform the boy into a wolf so that he might tear out his own father's throat. "Do this," the king said, "so that Lord Ambry will understand the bite of betrayal." Powerful magic was invoked, and the child was transformed. But though his body was changed, his spirit remained intact, and instead of biting the exposed neck of his father, he attacked his handlers, tearing them to pieces. A dozen of the King's knights perished under the wolf's teeth before they managed to drive it off into the night. Lord Ambry laughed from his chains even as the King ran him through with a sword. Now the heir to the lost house of Ambry, Banehallow wanders the trail as the Lycan, part warrior, part wolf, in search of justice for all that he lost.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_lycan_hype: As a man or as a wolf, Lycan devastates enemies with sharp claws and deadly jaws. Summoning stealthy wolves to scout ahead or assault a foe, his wolf transformation grants him the speed and strength to run down his enemies, or escape an ambush.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: The very enchantment that twisted his being also summons canine familiars.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Summons a pack of wolves to fight for Lycan.

In time, these wolves have Permanent Invisibility and Cripple.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Has a different cast backswing in Wolf Form.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value:
While Lycan is in Wolf Form, his wolves have haste movement and critical strike.

Does not grant them the bonus health component.

mechanics
fields.value:
{{Spellunit
| innate = true;1;1
| name = Lycan Wolf
| desc0 = The wolves always spawn in the same formation, facing the same angle as Lycan.

| icon1 = t0
| type1 = tal
| target1 = Passive
| desc1 = As his wolves become more integrated with Lycan, they developed the ability to subtly change themselves accordingly. The shifts are largely unconscious.

| icon2 = Lycan Lycan Wolf Invisibility
| type2 = bsc
| target2 = Passive
| desc2 = {{cf|Level|3+}} {{Show|A|Lycan Wolf|Invisibility|desc0}}

| icon3 = Lycan Lycan Wolf Cripple
| type3 = bsc
| target3 = Passive
| desc3 = {{cf|Level|4+}} {{Show|A|Lycan Wolf|Cripple|desc0}}

| icon4 = Reinforced
| type4 = bsc
| target4 = Passive

** The {{U|Lycan Wolf|text=Lycan Wolves}} are affected by the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|lycan_[[#Shapeshift|shapeshift]]_speed}} ability component.
** {{Symbol|bonus t1l4l}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|lycan_summon_wolves_bonus_damage}}
*** The following sources immediately update the current wolves:
*** Learning the {{ValueColor||attack damage increasing|10tal}} {{M|talent|t=t1l}}.
*** Learning the {{ValueColor||set base attack time|25tal}} {{M|talent|t=t4l}}.
** The following sources do not update the current wolves:

*** Learning the {{ValueColor||health increasing|15tal}} {{M|talent|t=t2r}}.

*** {{cf|shdnotes}} [[File:Dota2 Lycan Summon Wolves shd Formation icon.png|105px]]
**** The {{ValueColor||third|shd}} wolf [[File:Dota2 Letter-f.png|21px|F]] is created {{#var:Summon Wolves basic1}}-distance in front of Lycan, with wolf [[File:Dota2 Letter-p.png|21px|P]] and [[File:Dota2 Letter-q.png|21px|Q]] are now {{#var:Summon Wolves basic2}}-distance on the {{ValueColor||third|shd}} wolf's [[File:Dota2 West.png|31px|West]] and [[File:Dota2 East.png|31px|East]] respectively.
***** {{Code|OF {{=}} {{#var:Summon Wolves basic1}}}}
***** {{Code|PF {{=}} FQ {{=}} {{#var:Summon Wolves basic2}}}}
***** {{Code|PQ {{=}} {{#expr:{{#var:Summon Wolves basic2}}*2}}}}

fields.name: lore
fields.value: His animalistic symbiosis with canine kind gives Banehallow enhanced reflexes and hunting capabilities.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value: Grants bonus attack damage and bonus health regeneration to Lycan and all of his player-controlled units.

fields.name: interacts
buff2text
fields.value: Feral Impulse: Gaining x health regen and x% bonus damage.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Grants the following bonuses:
** Flat {{M|bonus attack damage}} based on the affected allied unit's current {{M|main attack damage}}, values are periodically checked and the bonus values are updated immediately.
** Flat bonus {{M|health regeneration}}.

* Does not affect the following units:
** {{M|Couriers}}
** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

* Affects the following units:
** All of Lycan's {{M|summons|text=player-controlled units}}.
** {{M|Hidden}} units.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: Forever a slave to his lycanthropy, Banehallow has come to accept his curse, and embrace his own savagery.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Assumes his lupine form.

The lycanthropy sets his base attack range, and grants bonus base night vision for the entire duration.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value:
Grants Lycan and his player-controlled units haste movement and critical strike.

However, the bonus health is only granted to Lycan himself.

fields.name: interacts
buff2text
fields.value: Shapeshift: Gaining haste and critical strike.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|a|Transform}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|lycan_shapeshift_transform}}
*#* The [[transformation]] does not persist through {{M|death}}.
*#* Applies a {{M|stun}} while transforming, and cannot be interrupted.
*# The ability has two main components, both components are applied to Lycan after the transformation time, and grants the following bonuses:
*#* [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|lycan_shapeshift}}
*#** Base bonus {{M|nighttime}} {{M|vision}}.
*#** {{Symbol|Melee}} {{Symbol|bonus atk}}
*#*** Turns Lycan into a [[melee]] unit and set his base [[attack range]] to {{#var:Shapeshift value2}} for the entire duration.
*#**** Does not affect attack range manipulating sources.
*#**** {{M|Items}} that use different values for the wielder's attack range-type now considers the caster as a melee unit.
*#* [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]] {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|lycan_shapeshift_speed}}
*#** The {{M|aura}} component affects the following units:
*#*** {{hi|Lycan}}
*#*** All Lycan's {{M|summons|text=player-controlled units}}.
*#** Grants the following bonuses:
*#*** {{Symbol|Critical Strike}}
*#**** The [[critical strike]] proc is determined during Lycan's or the affected ' {{M|attack point}} and uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#var:Shapeshift type1 value4}}}}.
*#**** The proc chance of multiple sources stack.
*#***** However, when multiple critical strike sources proc simutaneously, the higher critical factor takes precedence.
*#*** {{M|Haste movement}}.
*#*** Both bonus max and {{M|current health}}, utilizing [[setting health]].
*#** This ability component does not affect the following units:
*#*** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
*#*** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

* Recasting Shapeshift refreshes its duration and adapts the ability values correspondingly.

* {{cf|talnotes}} The following {{M|talent|t=t2l3r|text=talents}} apply to {{A|Lycan|Wolf Bite}} as well:
** The {{ValueColor||cooldown reduction|15tal}} {{M|talent|t=t2l|x}}.
** The {{ValueColor||duration increasing|20tal}} {{M|talent|t=t3r|x}}.

*#** The {{M|aura}} component affects the following units:

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Grants the unit-targeted allied hero all of Shapeshift's Wolf Form ability values of its corresponding level after its transformation time.

Within the proximity distance, the allied hero's lifesteal in Wolf Form heals Lycan, and Lycan's lifesteal heals the affected allied hero.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value: Lifesteal is less effective when attacking creeps.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: Grants the allied hero who assumed Wolf Form bonus health, haste movement, and critical strike of Shapeshift's correpsonding level.

fields.name: desc4
fields.value: Has a different cast backswing in Wolf Form.

claims.value:
Grants the unit-targeted allied hero all of Shapeshift's Wolf Form ability values of its corresponding level after its transformation time.

Within the proximity distance, the allied hero's lifesteal in Wolf Form heals Lycan, and Lycan's lifesteal heals the affected allied hero.
Grants Lycan lifesteal while the buff-affected allied hero is in Wolf Form.
Lifesteal is less effective when attacking creeps.
Grants the allied hero who assumed Wolf Form bonus health, haste movement, and critical strike of Shapeshift's correpsonding level.
Has a different cast backswing in Wolf Form.
Bite: Gaining Lifesteal when Lycan and the bitten hero are nearby.

abilities: Shapeshift gives max move speed and wolves to end games with fast pushes.
Heavy slows and Force Staff kite the melee wolf pack and stall his push.
items: Silver Edge's Break shuts off Lycan's passive abilities.
Mjollnir / Maelstrom's chain lightning clears Lycan's summons.
Heaven's Halberd disarms melee Lycan for several seconds.
Ghost Scepter makes you immune to Lycan's physical attacks.
Force Staff creates distance from melee Lycan.
Assault Cuirass's armor aura blunts Lycan's physical damage.
A lifesteal aura and a powerful dominated creep.
An ability upgrade for extra utility.
